_note: Hand-written plans for the invented Tidewater club, used when no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set (or --plan is not passed). The club plan passes planner.check against the album reading; each member plan against that member's own reading.

store.name: Tidewater Season
store.tagline: Dawn on the harbour, coffee after
store.about: Your club's season kept starting at the waterfront before sunrise and ending over coffee. These two pieces are for the clubhouse wall and floor, in the season's own colours.

products.title: Harbour Loop Rug
products.prompt: A printed flat rug, 4 x 6 ft: one continuous looping line in sunrise coral over a harbour-blue field, a fog-grey band along the bottom edge like early mist, simple bold shapes, no text, no logos.
products.why: Dawn harbour runs show up in 42% of the club's moments.

products.title: After the Run
products.prompt: An abstract wall print: a row of simple round cup shapes in buoy yellow and coral on a fog-grey ground, one asphalt-grey horizon line, flat matte colour, no text, no figures.
products.why: Post-run coffee is in 31% of the club's moments.

store.name: Your Season
store.tagline: The hills you kept going back to
store.about: Built only from the events you tagged yourself into. Your season leaned uphill more than the club's did.

products.title: Switchback Disc
products.prompt: A sterling silver pendant, brushed finish, 22 mm round disc with a raised zigzag line climbing from the bottom edge to a small polished dot near the top, 1.2 mm thick, simple bail, no stones, no text.
products.why: Trail switchbacks show up in 56% of the moments you tagged yourself into.
